reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs (confidentiality, independent-contractor, severability/survival) contain no non-solicitation, no-hire, anti-poaching or inducement covenant, so the preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer') is met on the face of the text.

Consistent with a compliant finding, the rendered text is identical to the original and no counterparty comment is proposed — the correct outcome, since adding a non-solicit would create a new restriction on our own client.

The failed deterministic sub-checks (duration ≤ 12 months; general-solicitation carve-out) are non-probative here: both presuppose an existing covenant and cannot be satisfied by absence, so they do not undermine the verdict.
Rationale is accurate and internally consistent, documents the fallback for future negotiation, and correctly notes that the survival list at p0070 identifies no restrictive covenant.
